Commands, flags, file paths and config keys stay verbatim. One status line about message screening. {held}, {breaker} and {rejected} are the three already-translated fragments below; keep the ' · ' separators and their order.

cli.team_bridge.status.screening_healthy.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge; 'receiver' is the background process that delivers messages. Commands, flags, file paths and config keys stay verbatim. The status line when no screened message is held and none was rejected in the last 24 hours. 'Screening' is the safety check every incoming agent message passes; 'breaker' is the circuit breaker that pauses screening after repeated provider failures.

cli.team_bridge.status.screening_held.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge; 'receiver' is the background process that delivers messages. Commands, flags, file paths and config keys stay verbatim. Messages parked by screening, waiting to be retried. {codes} is a verbatim list of technical hold codes with counts (e.g. 'breaker_open 9, provider_error 3'); {age} is a compact duration like '41m'. Never translate the codes.

cli.team_bridge.status.screening_held_cl.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge; 'receiver' is the background process that delivers messages. Commands, flags, file paths and config keys stay verbatim. As screening_held, plus {failure_class}: the verbatim technical code of the most common provider failure among held messages. Never translate it.

cli.team_bridge.status.screening_held_no.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge; 'receiver' is the background process that delivers messages. Commands, flags, file paths and config keys stay verbatim. Fragment: no message is parked by screening.

cli.team_bridge.status.screening_breaker.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge; 'receiver' is the background process that delivers messages. Commands, flags, file paths and config keys stay verbatim. Fragment: the screening circuit breaker. open = screening paused for {remaining} (compact duration like '4m'); failing = closed but with recent provider failures; other = closed and healthy.

cli.team_bridge.status.screening_rejecte.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge; 'receiver' is the background process that delivers messages. Commands, flags, file paths and config keys stay verbatim. Fragment: messages screening rejected in the last 24 hours. {categories} is a verbatim list of technical category codes with counts (e.g. 'personal_info_request 1'). Never translate the codes.

cli.team_bridge.notify.probe_suspected_t.role: local owner notification (inbox item) raised by the agent-messages receiver
cli.team_bridge.notify.probe_suspected_t.tone: calm, factual, operator-facing; no alarm, no blame
cli.team_bridge.notify.probe_suspected_t.note: Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge. Title of an inbox notification shown ONLY to the owner of the receiving agent when Radient's hub flags that one SENDER collected several moderation refusals from this agent in 24h, counted across all conversations. 'Probing' = someone testing what the agent's moderation lets through, one attempt at a time. Never names the sender, the message or the category.

cli.team_bridge.notify.probe_suspected_b.role: local owner notification (inbox item) raised by the agent-messages receiver
cli.team_bridge.notify.probe_suspected_b.tone: calm, factual, operator-facing; no alarm, no blame
cli.team_bridge.notify.probe_suspected_b.note: Body of the same owner-only notification. Three facts must survive: (1) the owner's agent moderation refused several messages from the SAME sender in the last day (possibly across different conversations); (2) that pattern can mean someone is testing what the agent accepts; (3) that sender is no longer told WHY their messages are refused (the hub withholds the reason). Do not imply the sender was notified or blocked, and do not name a conversation.
